description: Angular component class for configuring a slider widget, including form setup, validation, and configuration export.

classes.name: SliderBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring a slider widget, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for slider widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form values.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state and layout.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets widget config options based on selected card buttons.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string of the current value based on form settings.
